about: Wording changes the owner asked for. scripts/check-wording.mjs applies them to checkpoint-001.json (never edited) before it compares: on each listed route, the one baseline text node that is exactly `text` (or as many as `counts` gives for that route) becomes `to`, or is removed when `to` is null. An entry that is not used (its text is not on a route), that would reach more than its own node, or that has no date or no owner's words fails the check. Add an entry only with the owner's own words (README, Wording check).
